display.title: Chanukah: Hashem Is a G-d of Miracles
display.summary_short: Gazing at the lit menorah, Uncle Yossi explains that to Hashem a miracle and nature are the same, and why the Chanukah miracles remind us of the Creator.
display.summary_long: A Chanukah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given with the menorah already lit. Uncle Yossi explains that Hashem, who created nature, can change it at will, as He did with the Ten Plagues in Egypt. To Hashem there is no difference between a miracle and nature; the only difference is to us, because we get used to the sun, the moon and the stars and forget that they are Hashem's work. In fact, nature itself is the greatest miracle. A miracle, like the oil that burned for eight days or the few who defeated the many, wakes us up to see the Creator. The flickering flames whisper that Hashem is a G-d of miracles, and Uncle Yossi looks forward to the greatest miracle of all: Moshiach bringing everyone to Eretz Yisroel on the clouds, to see the golden menorah lit in the Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: Nature and miracles both come from Hashem; let the Chanukah lights remind us never to take His everyday wonders for granted.
